translation.proposed_text_en: (1) Upon the acquisition or production of depreciable fixed assets, the taxpayer may claim an investment allowance of up to 20% of the acquisition or production costs as a profit-reducing deduction.

clause_span.text: (1) Upon the acquisition or production of depreciable fixed assets, the taxpayer may claim an investment allowance of up to 20% of the acquisition or production costs as a profit-reducing deduction

conditions.text: Upon the acquisition or production of depreciable fixed assets
conditions.normalized: acquisition or production of depreciable fixed assets

constraints.text: up to 20% of the acquisition or production costs
constraints.normalized: maximum 20 percent of acquisition or production costs

records.rationale_summary: The taxpayer may claim an investment allowance upon acquiring or producing depreciable fixed assets, capped at 20% of acquisition or production costs and treated as a profit-reducing deduction.

translation.proposed_text_en: At the end of the fourth financial year following the year of acquisition or production, the investment allowances shall be transferred tax-free to a capital account or to a reserve deemed to have been taxed.

clause_span.text: At the end of the fourth financial year following the year of acquisition or production, the investment allowances shall be transferred tax-free to a capital account or to a reserve deemed to have been taxed

constraints.text: At the end of the fourth financial year following the year of acquisition or production
constraints.normalized: end of fourth financial year after acquisition or production year

constraints.text: to a capital account or to a reserve deemed to have been taxed
constraints.normalized: to capital account or deemed-taxed reserve

unsupported_or_ambiguous.reason: The transfer obligation is passive and no responsible accounting actor is expressly identified.

records.rationale_summary: Investment allowances must be transferred tax-free at the end of the fourth financial year following acquisition or production, either to a capital account or to a reserve deemed taxed.

translation.proposed_text_en:
(2) The investment allowance may only be claimed for business assets which
